Name: (Repeal) (DGA) Combination Table
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][size=6][color=#00ffff][/color][center][color=#00ffff]This mod has been discontinued and
a new Content Patcher version
has been released to work stably with SDV1.6.[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24031](CP) Combination Table[/url][/center][/size][/quote]



[size=3]The tables added by this mod are divided into left, middle, and right.[/size]
[size=3]The length can be freely changed by adjusting the number of tables placed in the middle.[/size]
[size=3]Also, each functions as a single table, so you can put things on each.[/size]

[size=3]Some desks do not have a middle part.[/size]
[size=3]These were originally 2x2 tables in vanilla, but have been changed to 2x1, which is a bonus.

Available from the Tables tab of the Furniture Catalog.
There is also a setting to hide it from the catalog from the ModConfig settings.
This is used to reduce the number of items in the catalog and make it easier to find other furniture.




[/size]
